description: LXT 1/2" 1/2" Brushless Impact Drill, Tool Only (XPH16Z) features a Makita built brushless motor that delivers 970 lbs. Max Torque for up to 70% more power than previous model for the most demanding drilling and drive applications.It is powered by a Makita brushless motor for longer runtime, increased power and speed, and longer tool lifeIt features a variable 2-speed design (0-550 and 0-1800 rpm) (0-8,250 and 0-27,000 BPM) that covers a wide range of drilling, driving applications and hammer. It also features a 1/2" all-metal gear housing for added durability on the jobsite.Practical features include a compact, ergonomic design of only 17.5cm long, double LED. lights and a soft rubberized handle for comfort. It weighs only 2.2 kg. With a 5.0Ah battery to reduce operator fatigue (battery sold separately).It is part of Makita's 18V LXT expandable system, the world's largest cordless tool system powered by 18V lithium-ion batteries. Makita 18V LXT lithium-ion batteries have the fastest charging times in their class, so they spend more time working and less time sitting on the charger.To improve tool performance and extend battery life, Makita created Star Protection Computer Controls. Star Protection is a communication technology that allows the tool and battery equipped with Star Protection to exchange data in real time and monitor conditions during use to protect against overcharging, over-discharge and overheating. For added versatility, the tool can also be powered by Makita 18V LXT lithium-ion batteries with the star symbol on the battery indicating protection of the stars inside.*Compared to XPH12
